caption: Hot water is poured over a pot of dried seaweed, and the crisp sheets swell and soften into flowing strands.

sa.check: A pot of dried seaweed sheets.
Hot water is poured over the seaweed.
The sheets soften into limp strands.
The sheets are crisp and flat at the start.
The pour comes first and the swelling follows.

pc.expect: The seaweed goes from crisp flat sheets to slippery limp strands that move with the water.
pc.fail: The sheets stay crisp and flat while fully wetted and moving; or a sheet shatters into dry shards under the water; or the seaweed melts into a liquid; or the strands stiffen into wire.

pc.expect: The swelling and softening only advance and the seaweed does not go crisp again in the water.
pc.fail: A softened strand goes crisp and flat again in the water; or the seaweed swells and shrinks in turn; or the seaweed is limp before the water reaches it; or the strands draw back into flat dry sheets.

pc.expect: Each sheet keeps being one piece of seaweed as it opens out and unfurls into strands.
pc.fail: A sheet splits into many separate whole sheets; or the seaweed turns into another material; or the sheets fuse into one smooth mass; or a sheet grows into a shape it never had, such as a ball.

pc.expect: The poured water falls downward into the pot, the seaweed sinks or drifts in it, and the water lies level.
pc.fail: The water travels upward from the jug; or a strand rises out of the water and hangs above it; or the water's surface tilts and stays tilted with the pot level; or the seaweed climbs the pot's wall and stays.

pc.expect: The seaweed in the pot is the seaweed that was there and the water comes only from the pour.
pc.fail: Seaweed appears in the pot with none added; or a sheet vanishes; or the water's level jumps with nothing poured; or seaweed passes through the pot's wall.

pc.expect: The pot, the jug and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or the jug changes shape; or items around the pot rearrange.

note: The seaweed darkening as it soaks is expected; its colour is not judged.
